title: Bitmine Amasses 4.17M ETH as Crypto and Cash Holdings Hit $14B
summary: Bitmine has further cemented its position as the largest corporate holder of Ether after adding more than 24,000 ETH to its balance sheet over the past week. The post Bitmine Amasses 4.17M ETH as Crypto and Cash Holdings Hit $14B appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: People in Iran describe heavy security and some damage in first calls to outside world
summary: Iranians could call abroad on Tuesday for the first time since communications were halted during a crackdown on nationwide protests in which activists said at least 646 people have been killed.

title: US sailor sentenced to 16 years in prison in Chinese espionage case
summary: Prosecutors accused sailor Jinchao Wei of selling information about US Navy ships to Chinese intelligence operatives.

title: Germany’s Merz Predicts Downfall of Iran’s Islamic Republic
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said the world is seeing the “final days” of Iran’s regime, as policymakers weigh the possibility of its fall and the far-reaching consequences for geopolitics and energy markets.
